packageRules.description: The amazonlinux container tags in test.yml are the supported install targets (they must match the OS labels published by jksy/imagemagick-build), not dependencies to bump.

Tools that CI builds from source (see .github/tools/). go.mod marks every dependency of a tool module `// indirect`, including the tool itself, so indirect dependencies are enabled. Their own dependencies are updated too, so security fixes are not left waiting for an upstream release.
Run go mod tidy so go.sum and the rest of the tool's dependencies follow the update.
A new Go major version is a different module path, which the tools would have to import themselves. Keep each tool to a single PR.
